decision_ref.summary: No intervention selected or recommended: every candidate worsens at least one metric, and the baseline is only partially validated.

disclosures: Reference data: these vehicles come from the published NGSIM file, not from video analysis by this system.
Vehicle classes are inferred from published lengths; the file has no class column.
Footage and trajectories are from Los Angeles in 2005, not Cairo.
